timeline.title: Finished Class 12
timeline.body: The results came out late in the year, too late for admissions that season.

timeline.title: A gap year
timeline.body: The late result meant waiting for the next admission cycle. Not every route is a straight line.

timeline.title: Started BCA
timeline.body: Assam Don Bosco University. First real brush with building software, not just studying it.

timeline.title: Finished BCA, shipped Safarnama
timeline.body: Graduated after building projects I actually cared about, the biggest being Safarnama.

timeline.title: Special Jury Award
timeline.body: Safarnama won Most Innovative Project and a ₹10,000 scholarship from the AEC Class 88′ Foundation.

timeline.title: Moved to Chennai for MCA
timeline.body: SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur (2025–27). A long way from home, and a good one.

timeline.title: Virtual internship at EDXcellence
timeline.body: Built DevBlog, a full-stack MERN blogging platform with JWT auth, likes, bookmarks and nested comments.

timeline.title: First open-source PR merged
timeline.body: My first pull request to an open-source project (firstcontributions) got merged. Small step, real one.

timeline.title: Building, practising, preparing
timeline.body: Building Wanderlens (my MCA capstone) and TripWise, practising DSA daily, and preparing for placements.

education.school: SRM Institute of Science and Technology
